name: 105-robust-eos-skip-into-short-section
description: Robustness: sleep at end of section, then a skip in the buffer from 15 across its section end into 16 (3.2 s, also closes a section). The skip is not playback, so 15's end does not stop; 16's end does: SleepFired once, parked at the start of 17.
